request: Add 0.2 mm chamfer to the hole edges to improve fitting.

parameters.apply_to: Both ends of each through-hole (entrance + exit edges)

actions.relational_constraint: Chamfer all circular edge loops created at the intersection between each hole’s cylindrical face and its adjacent planar faces (both sides of the through-hole) to add lead-in for assembly and reduce burr interference.
actions.unresolved_reference: Assumption applied: all functional through-holes on the part are intended (4x mounting holes in base bosses + 2x clevis pin bores) and chamfers are applied on both sides of each through-hole. If the intent is only mounting holes (or only one side/entrance), suppress the corresponding edge selections.
steps: Identify all through-hole cylindrical faces to drive robust edge selection: base mounting hole cylinders (S1 face_code 0007/0011/0015/0019) and clevis pin bore cylinders (S2 face_code 0030/0034).

For the 4x base mounting holes (Section S1): select the circular edge loop(s) where each mounting hole cylinder intersects the boss top seat plane (S1 face_code 0008, 0012, 0016, 0020). Apply a 0.2 mm equal-distance chamfer to these top entrance edges.

For the 4x base mounting holes (Section S1): select the circular edge loop(s) where each mounting hole cylinder intersects the bottom mounting datum plane (S1 face_code 0000). Apply a 0.2 mm equal-distance chamfer to these bottom exit edges (deburr/lead-in from underside).

For the 2x clevis pin bores (Section S2): select the circular edge loop(s) where each pin bore cylinder (S2 face_code 0030 and 0034) intersects the lug outer side planes (S2 face_code 0028 and 0032). Apply a 0.2 mm equal-distance chamfer to these outer entrance edges to improve pin insertion.

For the 2x clevis pin bores (Section S2): select the circular edge loop(s) where each pin bore cylinder intersects the lug inner side planes forming the clevis gap (S2 face_code 0029 and 0033). Apply a 0.2 mm equal-distance chamfer to these inner exit/entrance edges to remove sharpness and ease pin alignment through both lugs.

Regenerate and validate: ensure chamfers do not fail due to adjacent blends/fillets at hole transitions; if an edge is partially consumed by nearby fillets, apply chamfer by selecting the specific circular edge segment(s) rather than face-based auto-propagation.
